title: 🏛️ SEBI Equity Cash Closing Auction Session (CAS) — 3:15 to 3:35 PM (±3% Price Band)
theme: Secondary Market Trading & Price Discovery Mechanism
summary: SEBI decided to roll out Closing Auction Session (CAS) for F&O stocks from 3:15 pm to 3:35 pm (price band ±3% of VWAP) effective 3 August 2026, replacing pure 30-min VWAP.
